Letter of April 28, 1972, from Assistant to the Governor of Oregon, Office of the Governor.
Comment: The letter concurs with the comments by the Oregon State Game

Commission which were transmitted therewith. Those comments are related

to the transfer of State jurisdiction to the Federal Government for the

protection of certain endangered species.
Response: Such comments concern the proposed legislation rather than the draft environmental statement.
<u>Comment</u>: The author of the comment assumes that all authority to manage endangered species would be transferred.
Response: The proposed legislation would transfer authority only for proposed protection of certain endangered species not already covered under other Federal authority (i.e., Migratory Bird Act, Marine Manual Act, Lacey Act, and Bald Eagle Act). Further reply to the topic may be found in our replies to Indiana and Nebraska.
